Lumi is open source. Your data stays on your phone unless you connect a server of your own.
Define each PC once (name, host, token). Then choose which one each service uses and its port; pasting a full URL splits it.
No servers yet. Add one to connect Lumi Hub, My PC or web search.
Token (the Lumi Hub phone token; optional for search)
Claude and other agents on your PC, and their messages.
A SearXNG server. Without one, Lumi searches from the phone.
The server whose screens you can view.
Connected: %1$s results for a test search.
Not set up: add the address (and the token for the hub).
That address is not valid. Use https://name (plain http only for the emulator).
Can\'t reach the server. Is it running, and is Tailscale on in both devices?
Can\'t reach the search server. Check the address and that it is running.
The server took too long to answer. Check the connection (Tailscale) and try again.
The secure connection failed. Check the https address and the server certificate.
Wrong or expired token. Copy the phone token again from the hub.
The server refused this phone (not the owner, or the feature is off).
The search server refused the request. Turn on the JSON format in its settings.
The server answered but this address is not a Lumi Hub. Check the address.
The address answered but has no search page. Check it points to the SearXNG root.
The server has an internal error. Look at its log.
The server answered with something Lumi does not understand. Is it the right kind of server?
No server is assigned to the agents. Add one above and choose it.
Used by Claude chats unless a chat picks its own (tap the chip in the chat).
DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia, queried straight from the phone. No server, no key.
No search server assigned. Choose or add one, or type an address here.
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
This port serves a Lumi Hub without the My PC routes: update the hub on the PC (git pull) and restart lumi.
My PC view is off on the PC: run lumi_hub.py enable-pc-view and restart lumi.
The hub refused this phone (token or Tailscale account). Link the phone again with the token from the PC.
The remote desktop (RDP) of the PC, opened in the Microsoft Remote Desktop app. Uses the My PC server unless you pick another.
The remote desktop port is closed. Turn on Remote Desktop on the PC (see the hub README) and make sure Tailscale is on in both devices.
This PC\'s system can\'t share its screen with Lumi (it works on Windows). You can still take control with a remote desktop app.
Lumi will open the Microsoft Remote Desktop app pointed at %1$s. Control happens in that app, not in Lumi (this screen stays view only).
This PC runs %1$s: RDP needs xrdp there. VNC or SSH over Tailscale also work with other apps.
Set up the PC address first: Settings, Servers and PC.
No app on this phone handles remote desktop links (rdp://). Install Microsoft Remote Desktop (Windows App) and try again.
